content.text: [Discord #code-review dave Sat Mar 08 13:00 EST 2026] Per BOT_SUMMARY_REPORT.md the passenger_count nulls are only about 500k, so I don't think null handling is a priority. Let's skip it.
Caution: BOT_SUMMARY_REPORT.md is explicitly non-authoritative and known to under-count nulls. I will confirm the null count against data/reference/dataset_profile.json before deciding priority.

[Discord #code-review eve Sat Mar 08 13:20 EST 2026] Dave, that's wrong. I pulled the NYC Open Data columns API directly — passenger_count has 1,309,356 nulls (same as RatecodeID / congestion_surcharge / airport_fee). The 500k figure is a known BOT undercount. Null handling IS in scope.

Confirmed against the authoritative profile: passenger_count null_count = 1,309,356 (matching Eve's Open Data API pull), not the BOT's ~500k. Null handling is in scope; I'll use 1,309,356 as the headline.
